nodes.title: Turán's three-value question

nodes.summary: A function $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ has bounded value distribution if for every real $r > 0$ there is a natural number $C$ such that, for every value $w$ of the Riemann sphere $\mathbb{C} \cup \{\infty\}$ and every open disc of radius $r$, the multiplicities of $w$ as a value of $f$ at the points of any finite subset of the disc add up to at most $C$.
nodes.title: Bounded value distribution

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$. The multiplicity of $z$ as a pole of $f$, that is, the multiplicity of the value $\infty$ at $z$, is $-n$ if $f$ has finite meromorphic order $n < 0$ at $z$, and $0$ otherwise. In particular it is $0$ unless $f$ has a pole at $z$.
nodes.title: Multiplicity of a pole

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $z \in \mathbb{C}$, and let $w$ be a point of the Riemann sphere $\mathbb{C} \cup \{\infty\}$. The multiplicity of $w$ as a value of $f$ at $z$ is the multiplicity of $z$ as a root of $f = w$ when $w$ is finite, and the multiplicity of $z$ as a pole of $f$ when $w = \infty$.
nodes.title: Multiplicity of a value on the Riemann sphere

nodes.summary: Let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ and $w, z \in \mathbb{C}$. The multiplicity of $z$ as a root of the equation $f = w$ is an extended natural number: it is $\infty$ if $f(t) = w$ for every $t \neq z$ in some neighbourhood of $z$; otherwise it is $n$ if $f - w$ has meromorphic order $n \ge 0$ at $z$, and it is $0$ if that order is negative or $f - w$ is not meromorphic at $z$.
nodes.title: Multiplicity of a root of $f = w$
